allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is zero by default. This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.

approve(address,uint256).details: Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the caller's tokens. Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded. IMPORTANT: Beware that changing an allowance with this method brings the risk that someone may use both the old and the new allowance by unfortunate transaction ordering. One possible solution to mitigate this race condition is to first reduce the spender's allowance to 0 and set the desired value afterwards: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/20#issuecomment-263524729 Emits an {Approval} event.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the amount of tokens owned by `account`.

burn(address,uint256).details: Burn fyToken. This function can only be called by other Yield contracts, not users directly.

params.from: Wallet to burn the fyToken from.

chiAtMaturity().details: Spot price (exchange rate) between the base and an interest accruing token at maturity, set to 2^256-1 before maturity

convertToPrincipal(uint256).details: Converts a specified amount of underlying to principal

convertToUnderlying(uint256).details: Converts a specified amount of principal to underlying

maturity().details: Time at which redemptions are enabled.

maxRedeem(address).details: Gives the maximum amount an address holder can redeem in terms of the principal

maxWithdraw(address).details: Gives the maximum amount an address holder can withdraw in terms of the underlying

mint(address,uint256).details: Mint fyToken. This function can only be called by other Yield contracts, not users directly.

params.to: Wallet to mint the fyToken in.

mintWithUnderlying(address,uint256).details: Mint fyToken providing an equal amount of underlying to the protocol

previewRedeem(uint256).details: Gives the amount in terms of underlying that the princiapl amount can be redeemed for plus accrual

previewWithdraw(uint256).details: Gives the amount in terms of principal that the underlying amount can be withdrawn for plus accrual

redeem(address,uint256).details: Burn fyToken after maturity for an amount of underlying.

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: Burn fyToken after maturity for an amount of principal.

totalSupply().details: Returns the amount of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Moves `amount` tokens from the caller's account to `recipient`. Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Moves `amount` tokens from `sender` to `recipient` using the allowance mechanism. `amount` is then deducted from the caller's allowance. Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded. Emits a {Transfer} event.

underlying().details: Asset to be paid out on redemption.

underlyingId().details: Yield id of the asset to be paid out on redemption.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).details: Burn fyToken after maturity for an amount of underlying.
